q.sw: Pasipoti ni nini, na ni mali ya nani?
q.en: What is a passport, and who owns it?

sw.text: Pasipoti ni hati inayotolewa na Serikali kumwezesha raia wake kusafiri nje ya nchi kwa mujibu wa sheria za nchi anayokwenda au kupita.
list: Ingawa ina jina na taarifa zako, pasipoti hubaki kuwa mali ya Serikali na inaweza kuchukuliwa wakati wowote.
Usiibadilishe kwa namna yoyote wala kumruhusu mtu mwingine kuitumia.
Ikipotea au kuharibika, toa taarifa mara moja Ofisi ya Uhamiaji, Polisi au Ubalozi ulio karibu.

en.text: A passport is a Government-issued document enabling a citizen to travel abroad under the laws of the countries visited or transited.
list: Although it carries your name and details, it remains Government property and may be withdrawn at any time.
Never alter it or let anyone else use it.
If lost or damaged, report immediately to Immigration, the Police or the nearest Embassy.

q.sw: Pasipoti ya kielektroniki (e-Passport) ni nini?
q.en: What is the electronic passport (e-Passport)?

sw.text: Ni pasipoti yenye kifaa maalum cha kielektroniki (micro-chip) kinachohifadhi taarifa za mwenye pasipoti. Inakidhi viwango vya kimataifa, inafanana na pasipoti za nchi za Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki, na inasomeka kwenye mifumo ya viwanja vya ndege na mipakani duniani kote. Ada yake ni Tsh 150,000.
sw.note: Kama una pasipoti ya zamani (isiyo ya kielektroniki), omba mpya ukichagua aina ya ombi PASIPOTI IMEJAA/IMEISHA MUDA/KUPATA PASIPOTI NYINGINE.

en.text: A passport with an electronic micro-chip storing the holder's data. It meets international standards, matches EAC passports in appearance and is readable by airport and border systems worldwide. Fee: Tsh 150,000.
en.note: If you hold an old (non-electronic) passport, apply choosing FULL/EXPIRED/ANOTHER PASSPORT.

q.sw: Ninaombaje pasipoti?
q.en: How do I apply for a passport?

sw.text: Pasipoti ya Tanzania huombwa mtandaoni kisha ombi hukamilishwa ofisini.
steps: Fungua immigration.go.tz, nenda e-Services kisha Online Passport Application.
Chagua OMBI JIPYA (au ENDELEZA OMBI kama ulishaanza), kisha chagua aina ya ombi: pasipoti mpya, pasipoti imejaa/imeisha muda, iliyopotea au iliyoharibika.
Jaza taarifa zako kwa usahihi na kwa herufi kubwa, ambatisha picha na viambatisho.
Hakiki taarifa, weka alama ya tamko (Declaration) kisha thibitisha. Utapewa control number ya Tsh 20,000 — lipa ndani ya saa 48.
Chapisha fomu, ijazwe sehemu ya 7 na wadhamini na sehemu ya 9 na Hakimu/Wakili/Kamishna wa Viapo.
Wasilisha fomu na viambatisho Ofisi ya Uhamiaji ya Mkoa, Uhamiaji Kurasini au Afisi Kuu Zanzibar.
Afisa akiridhika utapewa control number ya Tsh 130,000. Ukishalipa utapigwa picha na kuchukuliwa alama za vidole, kisha utajulishwa siku ya kuchukua pasipoti.
sw.note: Kuwa makini unapochagua aina ya ombi — ada hutofautiana, na ukichagua kimakosa hutarudishiwa ada ya mwanzo.

en.text: A Tanzanian passport is applied for online and the application is completed at an office.
steps: Open immigration.go.tz, go to e-Services, then Online Passport Application.
Choose NEW APPLICATION (or CONTINUE APPLICATION), then the application type: new passport, full/expired passport, lost or damaged.
Fill in your details accurately in capital letters and attach your photo and documents.
Review, tick the Declaration and confirm. You receive a control number for Tsh 20,000 — pay within 48 hours.
Print the form; section 7 is completed by your guarantors and section 9 by a Magistrate/Advocate/Commissioner for Oaths.
Submit the form and documents at a Regional Immigration Office, Kurasini Immigration Office or the Zanzibar Head Office.
Once verified you get a control number for Tsh 130,000. After paying, your photo and fingerprints are taken and you are told when to collect the passport.
en.note: Choose the application type carefully — fees differ, and a wrong choice is not refunded.

q.sw: Ni viambatisho gani vinahitajika kuomba pasipoti?
q.en: What documents do I need for a passport?

sw.text: Viambatisho vya msingi kwa kila mwombaji ni:
list: Cheti cha kuzaliwa au kiapo cha kuzaliwa cha mwombaji (au cheti cha tajnisi kwa raia wa tajnisi).
Cheti/kiapo cha kuzaliwa cha mmoja wa wazazi, au cheti chake cha tajnisi.
Kitambulisho cha Taifa (NIDA).
Nakala ya pasipoti ya mzazi (kama anayo).
Barua ya maombi na picha moja ya pasipoti (background ya bluu bahari).
Uthibitisho wa shughuli unazofanya (mf. kitambulisho cha kazi na barua ya mwajiri, leseni ya biashara au TIN) au barua ya Serikali ya Mtaa inayothibitisha ukaazi wako.
sw.note: Ukiwa chini ya miaka 18, utafika ofisini na mzazi/mlezi na idhini yake ya maandishi. Afisa anaweza kuomba vielelezo vya ziada ikihitajika.

en.text: The basic documents for every applicant are:
list: Applicant's birth certificate or affidavit of birth (or naturalisation certificate).
A parent's birth certificate/affidavit or naturalisation certificate.
National ID (NIDA).
Copy of a parent's passport (if available).
Application letter and one passport photo (light blue background).
Proof of your activities (e.g. work ID and employer letter, business licence or TIN) or a local government letter confirming residence.
en.note: Applicants under 18 must come with a parent/guardian and written consent. The officer may request additional documents.

q.sw: Viambatisho vya ziada kulingana na aina ya safari ni vipi?
q.en: Extra documents by type of trip?

sw.text: Pamoja na viambatisho vya msingi, ambatisha kulingana na safari yako:
list: Safari binafsi: uthibitisho wa shughuli zako, barua ya mwaliko (na nakala ya pasipoti ya mwalikaji).
Ajira nje ya nchi: barua ya ajira au mkataba wa kazi, na vyeti vya taaluma.
Masomo: barua ya kukubaliwa chuoni, vyeti vya elimu, barua ya mfadhili au uthibitisho wa ada; idhini ya mwajiri au ya mzazi (chini ya miaka 18).
Matibabu: barua ya daktari aliyesajiliwa au idhini ya Wizara ya Afya.
Kikazi (rasmi): barua ya mwajiri na kitambulisho cha kazi.
Biashara: leseni ya biashara, TIN na barua ya Afisa Mtendaji wa Kata/Sheha.
Michezo: barua ya chama cha michezo kilichosajiliwa (mf. TFF/ZFA) na barua ya mwaliko.
Kidini: barua ya mwaliko na barua ya taasisi ya dini inayohusika.
Ubaharia: mkataba wa kazi, kitabu cha ubaharia (discharge book), vyeti vya ujuzi na barua ya chama cha mabaharia.

en.text: In addition to the basic documents, attach according to your trip:
list: Private trip: proof of activities, invitation letter (and inviter's passport copy).
Employment abroad: offer letter/contract and academic certificates.
Study: admission letter, certificates, sponsor letter or proof of fees; employer or parent consent (under 18).
Medical: letter from a registered doctor or Ministry of Health authority.
Official trip: employer letter and work ID.
Business: business licence, TIN and a letter from the Ward Executive Officer/Sheha.
Sports: letter from a registered sports association (e.g. TFF/ZFA) and invitation.
Religious: invitation and a letter from the religious organisation.
Seaman: employment contract, discharge book, certificates and seamen union letter.

q.sw: Mambo gani ya kuzingatia wakati wa kujaza fomu ya pasipoti?
q.en: Tips for filling the passport form?

list: Hakikisha una viambatisho vyote kabla ya kuanza.
Jaza taarifa kwa herufi kubwa, kwa usahihi na ukamilifu.
Majina yafanane na yaliyo kwenye cheti/kiapo cha kuzaliwa. Yakitofautiana utahitaji kiapo au hati ya kubadili jina (Deed Poll).
Kosa ukiliona baada ya kuchapisha fomu, lirekebishe kwa kalamu ya wino na usaini pembeni yake.
Kiapo cha kuzaliwa kiwe na stempu ya ushuru kama Sheria ya Viapo inavyoelekeza.
Pasipoti ikichapishwa na makosa kutokana na taarifa zako, utajaza fomu upya na kulipa ada kamili (Tsh 150,000).
Have all documents ready before you start.
Fill in details in capital letters, accurately and completely.
Names must match your birth certificate/affidavit; if they differ you need an affidavit or Deed Poll.
If you spot an error after printing, correct it in ink and sign beside it.
An affidavit of birth must carry the revenue stamp required by law.
If the passport is printed with errors from your own details, you must re-apply and pay the full fee (Tsh 150,000).

q.sw: Mtoto chini ya miaka 18 anapataje pasipoti?
q.en: How does a child under 18 get a passport?

sw.text: Mtoto huombewa pasipoti kwa utaratibu ule ule wa kawaida, kwa kuongeza haya:
list: Mzazi au mlezi anayetambulika kisheria afike naye ofisini wakati wa kuwasilisha fomu.
Idhini ya maandishi ya mzazi/mlezi kuhusu safari ya mtoto.
Kitambulisho cha Taifa cha mzazi pale mtoto hana kitambulisho chake.

en.text: A child applies through the normal procedure, plus:
list: A legally recognised parent/guardian must accompany the child when submitting.
Written consent of the parent/guardian for the trip.
The parent's National ID where the child has none.

q.sw: Nawasilisha fomu ya pasipoti wapi?
q.en: Where do I submit my passport form?

list: Ofisi ya Uhamiaji ya Mkoa iliyo karibu nawe.
Ofisi ya Uhamiaji Kurasini (Dar es Salaam).
Uhamiaji Makao Makuu (Dodoma) au Afisi Kuu ya Uhamiaji Zanzibar.
Ukiwa nje ya nchi: Ubalozi wa Tanzania ulio karibu nawe.
sw.note: Wasilisha fomu uliyochapisha pamoja na viambatisho vyote baada ya kulipa Tsh 20,000.

list: Your nearest Regional Immigration Office.
Kurasini Immigration Office (Dar es Salaam).
Immigration Headquarters (Dodoma) or the Zanzibar Head Office.
If abroad: the nearest Tanzanian Embassy.
en.note: Submit the printed form with all attachments after paying Tsh 20,000.

q.sw: Ninaombaje pasipoti nikiwa nje ya nchi?
q.en: How do I apply for a passport while abroad?

steps: Jaza fomu mtandaoni ukichagua 'Mwombaji aliye nje ya nchi'.
Lipa ada yote kwa mkupuo: USD 90 (USD 265 kwa pasipoti iliyopotea) kwa kadi (Mastercard/Debit) au benki (Swift).
Chapisha fomu na uiwasilishe pamoja na viambatisho kwenye Ubalozi wa Tanzania.
sw.note: USD 90 inajumuisha ada ya maombi (USD 15) na ada ya pasipoti (USD 75); gharama za benki ni za ziada.

steps: Fill the online form choosing 'Applicant outside the country'.
Pay the full fee at once: USD 90 (USD 265 for a lost passport) by card or bank Swift transfer.
Print the form and submit it with attachments at the Tanzanian Embassy.
en.note: USD 90 covers the application fee (USD 15) and passport fee (USD 75); bank charges are extra.

q.sw: Nimechagua aina ya ombi kimakosa na nimeshalipa — nifanye nini?
q.en: I chose the wrong application type and paid — what now?

sw.text: Ada iliyolipwa kwa aina ya ombi iliyochaguliwa kimakosa hairudishwi wala haihamishwi. Utalazimika kujaza fomu nyingine kwa usahihi na kulipia ada ya aina sahihi. Kwa hiyo hakiki aina ya ombi (mpya, imejaa/imeisha muda, iliyopotea au iliyoharibika) kabla ya kulipa.

en.text: A fee paid under a wrongly chosen application type is not refunded or transferred. You must fill a new form correctly and pay the correct fee. Check the application type (new, full/expired, lost or damaged) before paying.

q.sw: Ada ya pasipoti ni kiasi gani?
q.en: How much is the passport fee?

sw.text: Ada ya pasipoti ukiomba ukiwa Tanzania ni Tsh 150,000. Inalipwa kwa awamu mbili:
steps: Ukimaliza kujaza fomu mtandaoni, unalipia Tsh 20,000 (ada ya maombi).
Unakamilisha taratibu zote na kuwasilisha fomu pamoja na viambatisho kwenye Ofisi ya Uhamiaji, ambapo zinakaguliwa.
Mwisho unalipia Tsh 130,000 kwa control number.
sw.note: Malipo yote hufanywa kwa control number kupitia simu au benki. Ukiomba ukiwa nje ya nchi (kupitia Ubalozi), ada ni USD 90, inayolipwa yote baada ya kujaza fomu.

en.text: The passport fee when applying in Tanzania is Tsh 150,000, paid in two instalments:
steps: After completing the online form, pay Tsh 20,000 (application fee).
Complete all requirements and submit the form with attachments at the Immigration Office, where they are checked.
Finally, pay Tsh 130,000 using the control number.
en.note: All payments are made with a control number via mobile money or bank. If you apply from abroad (through an Embassy), the fee is USD 90, paid in full after completing the form.

q.sw: Ninalipaje ada ya pasipoti?
q.en: How do I pay the passport fee?

list: Malipo yote hufanywa kwa control number uliyopewa na mfumo — zingatia kiasi na aina ya fedha iliyoonyeshwa.
Ukiwa Tanzania: lipa kwa simu (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money — Lipa Bili/Malipo ya Serikali) au benki.
Ukiwa nje ya nchi: lipa kwa kadi (Mastercard/Debit) au benki (Swift Transfer).
Baada ya malipo utapokea SMS ya uthibitisho; rudi kwenye OMBI LINALOENDELEA ili kupakua na kuchapisha fomu.
sw.note: Usimkabidhi afisa yeyote fedha ili akulipie.

list: All payments use the control number issued by the system — pay the exact amount and currency shown.
In Tanzania: pay by mobile money (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money — bill/government payments) or bank.
Abroad: pay by card (Mastercard/Debit) or bank Swift transfer.
You receive an SMS confirmation; return to CONTINUING APPLICATION to download and print your form.
en.note: Never hand cash to an officer to pay for you.

q.sw: Ada ya pasipoti iliyopotea au kuharibika ni kiasi gani?
q.en: Fee for a lost or damaged passport?

sw.text: Ada ya kubadilisha pasipoti iliyopotea au kuharibika ni kubwa kuliko ya kawaida:
list: Iliyopotea kwa mara ya kwanza: Tsh 500,000 (USD 265 ukiomba ubalozini).
Iliyopotea kwa mara ya pili: Tsh 750,000 (USD 365).
Iliyoharibika: Tsh 300,000 (USD 165).
sw.note: Chagua aina sahihi ya ombi (PASIPOTI ILIYOPOTEA au ILIYOHARIBIKA). Kiasi halisi cha kulipa huonekana kwenye control number yako.

en.text: Replacing a lost or damaged passport costs more than a normal one:
list: Lost for the first time: Tsh 500,000 (USD 265 via an embassy).
Lost for the second time: Tsh 750,000 (USD 365).
Damaged: Tsh 300,000 (USD 165).
en.note: Choose the correct application type (LOST or DAMAGED). The exact amount appears with your control number.

group.sw: Aina za pasipoti na hati za safari

q.sw: Kuna aina gani za pasipoti?
q.en: What types of passports are there?

sw.text: Idara ya Uhamiaji inatoa aina tatu za pasipoti:
list: Pasipoti ya Kawaida (rangi ya bluu) — kwa raia yeyote wa Tanzania; inadumu miaka 10.
Pasipoti ya Kiutumishi (rangi ya kijani) — kwa viongozi wa Serikali waliotajwa kwenye Sheria ya Pasipoti; inadumu miaka 5; inahitaji barua ya utambulisho kutoka Utumishi.
Pasipoti ya Kidiplomasia (rangi nyekundu) — kwa viongozi wenye hadhi maalum; inadumu miaka 5; inahitaji barua ya Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje.
sw.note: Zote zinatumika kwenda nchi zote duniani. Mwenye pasipoti ya kiutumishi au kidiplomasia akistaafu au kuondoka kwenye nafasi hiyo, anatakiwa kuirudisha Uhamiaji na kutumia pasipoti ya kawaida.

en.text: The Immigration Department issues three passport types:
list: Ordinary (blue) — any Tanzanian citizen; valid 10 years.
Service (green) — government officials listed in the Passports Act; valid 5 years; needs an introduction letter from the Public Service office.
Diplomatic (red) — officials with special status; valid 5 years; needs a Ministry of Foreign Affairs letter.
en.note: All are valid for all countries. Holders of service/diplomatic passports must return them when they leave the position and use an ordinary passport.

group.sw: Aina za pasipoti na hati za safari

q.sw: Pasipoti inadumu muda gani, na ikijaa nifanye nini?
q.en: How long is a passport valid, and what if it is full?

sw.text: Pasipoti ya kawaida inadumu miaka 10; ya kiutumishi na ya kidiplomasia miaka 5.
steps: Ikiisha muda au kurasa zikijaa, omba mtandaoni ukichagua aina ya ombi PASIPOTI IMEJAA/IMEISHA MUDA.
Ambatisha barua ya maombi na pasipoti yako ya awali.
Endelea na malipo na uwasilishaji kama ombi la kawaida.

en.text: An ordinary passport is valid for 10 years; service and diplomatic passports for 5 years.
steps: When it expires or is full, apply online choosing FULL/EXPIRED PASSPORT.
Attach an application letter and your previous passport.
Continue with payment and submission as a normal application.

group.sw: Aina za pasipoti na hati za safari

q.sw: Hati ya Dharura ya Kusafiria (ETD) ni nini na ninaipataje?
q.en: What is an Emergency Travel Document (ETD) and how do I get it?

sw.text: ETD hutolewa kwa raia wa Tanzania mwenye safari ya dharura asiyeweza kupata pasipoti kwa wakati, au aliyekwama/kupoteza pasipoti nje ya nchi. Inatumika kwa safari moja tu (kwenda na kurudi) na hukabidhiwa kwa Afisa Uhamiaji ukirejea.
steps: Omba mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa ETD (e-Services).
Ukiwa na NIDA, au uliwahi kuwa na e-passport/e-ETD, unaweza kulipa na kujichapishia ETD yako mwenyewe.
Usipokuwa navyo, omba kwa kutumia NIDA au e-passport ya mdhamini, kisha fika ofisi ya Uhamiaji iliyo karibu kwa uhakiki na kuichukua.
Ada ni Tsh 20,000 (USD 20 ukiwa nje ya nchi). Kwa kawaida hati hutolewa ndani ya saa 24.
sw.note: Viambatisho: cheti/kiapo cha kuzaliwa, cheti cha kuzaliwa cha mzazi au cha tajnisi, kitambulisho cha NIDA na barua ya Afisa Mtendaji wa Kata. Kama pasipoti ilipotea, ambatisha Police Loss Report.

en.text: An ETD is issued to a Tanzanian citizen with an urgent trip who cannot get a passport in time, or who is stranded/lost a passport abroad. It is valid for one trip (out and back) and is surrendered to the Immigration Officer on return.
steps: Apply online through the ETD system (e-Services).
With a NIDA number, or a previous e-passport/e-ETD, you can pay and self-print your ETD.
Without them, apply using a guarantor's NIDA or e-passport, then visit the nearest immigration office for verification and collection.
The fee is Tsh 20,000 (USD 20 abroad). It is usually issued within 24 hours.
en.note: Documents: birth certificate/affidavit, a parent's birth or naturalisation certificate, NIDA ID and a Ward Executive Officer letter. If a passport was lost, attach a Police Loss Report.

group.sw: Aina za pasipoti na hati za safari

q.sw: Certificate of Identity na Convention Travel Document ni nini?
q.en: What are the Certificate of Identity and Convention Travel Document?

list: Hati ya Utambulisho (Certificate of Identity): hutolewa kwa mtu asiye raia wa Tanzania aliye nchini, asiyeweza kupata pasipoti ya nchi yake (mf. amepoteza pasipoti na nchi yake haina ubalozi Tanzania), ili aweze kusafiri. Viambatisho: Police Loss Report, maelezo ya jinsi pasipoti ilivyopotea, ushahidi wa kuzaliwa Tanzania (kama alizaliwa hapa) na picha 2. Ada ni Tsh 10,000.

Hati ya Kusafiria ya Mkataba wa Geneva (Convention Travel Document): hutolewa kwa mkimbizi aliyepewa hifadhi Tanzania anayehitaji kusafiri nje. Viambatisho: barua ya Mkurugenzi wa Idara ya Wakimbizi, nakala ya kitambulisho cha ukimbizi na picha 2.
Hati zote mbili hutolewa Uhamiaji Makao Makuu na Afisi Kuu Zanzibar.

Certificate of Identity: issued to a non-citizen in Tanzania who cannot obtain a passport from their country (e.g. lost passport and no embassy in Tanzania) so they can travel. Documents: Police Loss Report, written account of the loss, proof of birth in Tanzania if applicable, and 2 photos. Fee: Tsh 10,000.
Convention Travel Document: issued to a refugee granted asylum in Tanzania who needs to travel abroad. Documents: letter from the Director of Refugees, copy of refugee ID and 2 photos.
Both are issued at Immigration Headquarters and the Zanzibar Head Office.

group.sw: Aina za pasipoti na hati za safari

q.sw: Masharti ya pasipoti ya kiutumishi na ya kidiplomasia ni yapi?
q.en: Requirements for service and diplomatic passports?

sw.text: Viambatisho ni vilevile vya pasipoti ya kawaida (cheti cha kuzaliwa, cha mzazi, NIDA, uthibitisho wa safari, picha 1 na ada ya Tsh 150,000), pamoja na:
list: Pasipoti ya kiutumishi: barua ya utambulisho kutoka Ofisi ya Rais — Menejimenti ya Utumishi wa Umma na Utawala Bora.
Pasipoti ya kidiplomasia: barua ya utambulisho kutoka Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje na Ushirikiano wa Afrika Mashariki.
sw.note: Zinatolewa kwa wanaostahili kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Pasipoti na Hati za Safari, na zinadumu miaka 5.

en.text: Same documents as an ordinary passport (birth certificate, parent's certificate, NIDA, trip evidence, 1 photo and Tsh 150,000), plus:
list: Service passport: introduction letter from the President's Office — Public Service Management.
Diplomatic passport: introduction letter from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and East African Cooperation.
en.note: Issued to those entitled under the Passports and Travel Documents Act; valid 5 years.

q.sw: Pasipoti yangu imepotea au imeibiwa, nifanye nini?
q.en: My passport is lost or stolen — what do I do?

steps: Toa taarifa polisi upate Police Loss Report.

Toa taarifa kwa maandishi Ofisi ya Uhamiaji iliyo karibu (ukiwa nje ya nchi — Ubalozini). Unaweza pia kupiga +255 262 323542 / +255 262 323532 au kutuma barua pepe lostpassport@immigration.go.tz ukieleza jina kamili, namba ya pasipoti (kama unaikumbuka), tarehe na mahali ilipopotea na mazingira ya upotevu.
Tangaza upotevu kwenye magazeti mawili — moja la Kiswahili na moja la Kiingereza.
Andaa tamko la kiapo (sworn declaration) na barua ya kueleza mazingira ya upotevu kwa Kamishna Jenerali wa Uhamiaji.
Omba pasipoti mpya mtandaoni ukichagua PASIPOTI ILIYOPOTEA, ukiambatisha pia cheti chako cha kuzaliwa, cha mzazi, ushahidi wa safari na picha 1.
sw.note: Utahojiwa na Afisa Mdhibiti wa Pasipoti kabla ya kupewa nyingine. Uliyepoteza pasipoti nje ya nchi, ambatisha ETD uliyopewa ubalozini.

steps: Report to the police and obtain a Police Loss Report.

Report in writing to the nearest Immigration Office (abroad — the Embassy). You may also call +255 262 323542 / +255 262 323532 or email lostpassport@immigration.go.tz with your full name, passport number (if known), date/place of loss and circumstances.
Publish the loss in two newspapers — one Kiswahili and one English.
Prepare a sworn declaration and a letter explaining the circumstances to the Commissioner General of Immigration.
Apply online choosing LOST PASSPORT, attaching your and a parent's birth certificates, evidence of the trip and 1 photo.
en.note: A Passport Control Officer will interview you before a replacement is issued. If you lost it abroad, attach the ETD issued by the embassy.

q.sw: Pasipoti yangu imeharibika au imeungua, nifanye nini?
q.en: My passport is damaged or burnt — what do I do?

steps: Omba pasipoti nyingine mtandaoni ukichagua PASIPOTI ILIYOHARIBIKA/KUUNGUA MOTO.
Ambatisha barua inayoeleza jinsi ilivyoharibika.
Wasilisha pasipoti iliyoharibika wakati wa kuwasilisha ombi.
sw.note: Kama iliungua moto, ambatisha pia barua ya Mwenyekiti/Afisa Mtendaji wa Kata na ripoti ya Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji.

steps: Apply online choosing DAMAGED/BURNT PASSPORT.
Attach a letter explaining how it was damaged.
Submit the damaged passport with your application.
en.note: If it was burnt, also attach a letter from the Ward Executive Office and a Fire and Rescue report.

q.sw: Pasipoti inaweza kufutwa kwa sababu gani?
q.en: When can a passport be revoked?

sw.text: Pasipoti ni mali ya Serikali. Kamishna Jenerali wa Uhamiaji anaweza kuifuta pale ambapo:
list: Mwenye pasipoti amemruhusu mtu mwingine kuitumia.
Amefukuzwa au kurejeshwa nchini kwa gharama za Serikali.
Amekoma kuwa raia wa Tanzania.
Anajihusisha na dawa za kulevya, utakatishaji fedha, usafirishaji haramu wa binadamu, ugaidi au miamala mingine haramu.
Ni kwa maslahi au usalama wa Taifa.

en.text: A passport is Government property. The Commissioner General may revoke it where:
list: The holder allows another person to use it.
The holder was deported or repatriated at Government expense.
The holder has ceased to be a Tanzanian citizen.
The holder engages in drug trafficking, money laundering, migrant smuggling, terrorism or other illegal dealings.
It is in the national interest or for national security.

q.sw: Ninafuatiliaje ombi langu la pasipoti?
q.en: How do I track my passport application?

steps: Fungua Online Passport Application kupitia e-Services kwenye immigration.go.tz.
Chagua ANGALIA OMBI kufuatilia ombi ulilokamilisha.
Kama bado hujakamilisha fomu, chagua ENDELEZA OMBI.
sw.note: Ukishapigwa picha na kuchukuliwa alama za vidole, utajulishwa siku ya kufika kuchukua pasipoti yako.

steps: Open Online Passport Application under e-Services at immigration.go.tz.
Choose CHECK APPLICATION to follow a completed application.
If the form is unfinished, choose CONTINUE APPLICATION.
en.note: After photo and fingerprint capture you are told the day to collect your passport.

q.sw: Visa ni nini, na nani anaihitaji?
q.en: What is a visa and who needs one?

sw.text: Visa ni ruhusa anayopewa mgeni anayekusudia kuingia Tanzania kwa ajili ya kutembelea, utalii, mapumziko, biashara, matibabu, mikutano au shughuli nyingine halali. Raia wa nchi nyingi wanahitaji visa; raia wa nchi zilizoorodheshwa kuwa hazihitaji visa hupewa Visitor's Pass wakifika.

en.text: A visa is permission granted to a foreigner intending to enter Tanzania for a visit, tourism, holiday, business, treatment, conferences or other lawful activities. Most nationals need a visa; visa-exempt nationals receive a Visitor's Pass on arrival.

q.sw: Ninaombaje visa ya Tanzania?
q.en: How do I apply for a Tanzania visa?

sw.text: Visa huombwa mtandaoni kupitia tovuti rasmi ya Uhamiaji pekee.
steps: Fungua immigration.go.tz na bofya APPLY NOW (e-Visa).
Jaza taarifa zote kwenye fomu.
Pakia (upload) nyaraka zinazohitajika kwa aina ya visa yako.
Utapokea barua pepe yenye namba ya utambulisho wa ombi — itumie kufuatilia ombi.
Lipa ada ya visa husika, kisha wasilisha ombi.
Utapokea ujumbe wa kuthibitisha kuwa ombi limepokelewa.
sw.note: Tumia tovuti rasmi pekee, si viungo vingine. Pasipoti iwe na muda usiopungua miezi 6 na angalau ukurasa mmoja mtupu wa visa.

en.text: Visas are applied for online through the official Immigration website only.
steps: Open immigration.go.tz and click APPLY NOW (e-Visa).
Fill in all details on the form.
Upload the documents required for your visa type.
You will receive an email with an application ID — use it to track the application.
Pay the visa fee, then submit.
You will receive a confirmation that the application was received.
en.note: Use only the official website. Your passport must have at least 6 months' validity and one blank visa page.

q.sw: Ombi la visa linachukua muda gani?
q.en: How long does a visa take?

list: Maombi ya visa hushughulikiwa ndani ya siku 10 — omba mapema.
Wanaohitaji Referral Visa waombe angalau wiki 6 hadi miezi 2 kabla ya safari.
Ombi lisilo sahihi au lisilo na viambatisho vya kutosha linaweza kukataliwa, na ada ya visa iliyokataliwa hairudishwi.
Visa applications are processed within 10 days — apply early.
Referral Visa applicants should apply at least 6 weeks to 2 months before travel.
Incorrect or incomplete applications may be rejected, and fees for rejected visas are not refunded.

q.sw: Ninafuatiliaje ombi langu la visa?
q.en: How do I track my visa application?

steps: Ingia kwenye mfumo wa maombi ya visa kwa kutumia namba ya utambulisho uliyotumiwa kwa barua pepe.
Angalia hali ya ombi au pakua Visa Grant Notice.
Fuatilia pia barua pepe uliyotumia kwenye maombi.
sw.note: Kama visa haijashughulikiwa ndani ya muda, wasiliana kupitia visatanzania@immigration.go.tz au info@immigration.go.tz.

steps: Sign in to the visa portal using the application ID sent to your email.
Check the status or download your Visa Grant Notice.
Also watch the email you used in the application.
en.note: If it is not processed in time, contact visatanzania@immigration.go.tz or info@immigration.go.tz.

q.sw: Je, watoto wanahitaji ombi lao la visa?
q.en: Do children need their own visa application?

sw.text: Ndiyo. Kila mwenye pasipoti anatakiwa kuwa na ombi lake la visa — hata mtoto aliyeandikwa kwenye pasipoti au ombi la mzazi.

en.text: Yes. Every passport holder needs a separate visa application — even a child listed on a parent's passport or application.

q.sw: Je, visa inanihakikishia kuingia nchini?
q.en: Does a visa guarantee entry?

sw.text: Hapana. Visa si ruhusa ya mwisho ya kuingia. Afisa Uhamiaji kwenye kituo cha kuingilia anaweza kukataa kumruhusu mwenye visa kama hajatimiza masharti ya kuingia au uwepo wake ni kinyume na maslahi ya Taifa.

en.text: No. A visa is not final authority to enter. The Immigration Officer at the entry point may refuse entry if requirements are not met or the person's presence is against the national interest.

q.sw: Je, nahitaji visa tofauti kwa Zanzibar?
q.en: Do I need a separate visa for Zanzibar?

sw.text: Hapana. Visa ya Tanzania inatumika Tanzania Bara na Zanzibar. Wakati wa kuomba, chagua mahali utakapoanzia safari.

en.text: No. A Tanzania visa covers both the Mainland and Zanzibar. When applying, select your first destination.

q.sw: Pasipoti yangu inatakiwa kuwa na sifa gani kuomba visa?
q.en: What must my passport have to apply for a visa?

list: Muda wa matumizi usiopungua miezi 6.
Angalau ukurasa mmoja mtupu wa visa.
Kila mwenye pasipoti (hata mtoto) awe na ombi lake la visa.
At least 6 months' validity.
At least one blank visa page.
Every passport holder (including children) needs a separate application.

q.sw: Visa ikikataliwa nitarudishiwa ada?
q.en: Will I be refunded if my visa is rejected?

list: Hapana — ada ya visa iliyokataliwa hairudishwi.
Idara inaweza kutoa au kutotoa sababu za kukataa.
Ombi la aina isiyo sahihi au lisilo na viambatisho vya kutosha linaweza kukataliwa — chagua aina sahihi ya visa.
Masharti ya visa yanaweza kubadilika wakati wowote bila taarifa ya awali.
sw.note: Kama huna uhakika wa aina ya visa unayohitaji, uliza kwanza kupitia visatanzania@immigration.go.tz au info@immigration.go.tz.

list: No — fees for rejected visas are not refunded.
The Department may give or withhold reasons for rejection.
Wrong-category or poorly documented applications may be rejected — choose the right visa.
Visa rules may change at any time without notice.
en.note: If unsure which visa you need, ask first via visatanzania@immigration.go.tz or info@immigration.go.tz.

q.sw: Nitajuaje kuwa ninaomba visa kwenye tovuti sahihi?
q.en: How do I know I am applying on the right website?

sw.text: Omba visa kupitia tovuti rasmi ya Idara ya Uhamiaji pekee (www.immigration.go.tz → APPLY NOW / e-Services) na si kupitia viungo au mawakala wengine. Kila mwombaji anachukuliwa kuwa amesoma na kukubali masharti (Disclaimer) yaliyo mwishoni mwa ombi kabla ya kulipa.

en.text: Apply only through the official Immigration website (www.immigration.go.tz → APPLY NOW / e-Services), not other links or agents. Every applicant is deemed to have read and accepted the Disclaimer at the end of the application before paying.

q.sw: Kuna aina gani za visa?
q.en: What types of visas are there?

sw.text: Tanzania inatoa visa za aina sita kulingana na madhumuni ya safari:
list: Ordinary Visa — utalii, kutembelea, mikutano, matibabu; kuingia mara moja, hadi miezi 3.
Business Visa — kazi za muda mfupi (kufunga/kutengeneza mitambo, mafunzo, ukaguzi wa hesabu); hadi siku 90.
Multiple Entry Visa — wanaohitaji kuingia mara kwa mara; hadi miezi 12 (lazima kutoka nchini angalau kila miezi 3).
Student Visa — masomo katika taasisi zinazotambulika.
Transit Visa — kupita Tanzania kwenda nchi nyingine; hadi siku 7.
Gratis (Diplomatic) Visa — wenye pasipoti za kidiplomasia/kiutumishi walio kazini rasmi, bila malipo.

en.text: Tanzania issues six visa types depending on the purpose of travel:
list: Ordinary Visa — tourism, visits, conferences, treatment; single entry, up to 3 months.
Business Visa — short assignments (machine repair, training, auditing); up to 90 days.
Multiple Entry Visa — frequent visitors; up to 12 months (must leave at least every 3 months).
Student Visa — study at recognised institutions.
Transit Visa — passing through to another country; up to 7 days.
Gratis (Diplomatic) Visa — diplomatic/service passport holders on official duty, free of charge.

q.sw: Ordinary Visa ni nini na masharti yake?
q.en: What is an Ordinary Visa and its requirements?

sw.text: Ni visa ya kuingia mara moja kwa muda usiozidi miezi 3 kwa ajili ya utalii, kutembelea ndugu, mapumziko, mikutano, matibabu au shughuli nyingine halali.
list: Pasipoti yenye muda usiopungua miezi 6.
Ada ya visa (USD 50).
Picha 1 ya pasipoti.
Tiketi ya kurudi.

en.text: A single-entry visa for up to 3 months for tourism, visiting family, holidays, conferences, treatment or other lawful activity.
list: Passport valid for at least 6 months.
Visa fee (USD 50).
1 passport photo.
Return ticket.

q.sw: Business Visa ni nini na masharti yake?
q.en: What is a Business Visa and its requirements?

aliases: visa ya kazi ya muda mfupi

sw.text: Hutolewa mara moja kwa mgeni anayekuja kwa kazi maalum za muda mfupi (hadi siku 90) — mf. kufunga au kutengeneza mitambo, kutoa mafunzo mafupi, ukaguzi wa hesabu au biashara halali.
list: Pasipoti yenye muda usiopungua miezi 6.
Ada ya visa (USD 250).
Picha 1 ya pasipoti na tiketi ya kurudi.
Nyaraka za usajili wa kampuni inayomwalika (leseni ya biashara au Certificate of Incorporation).
Mkataba au barua ya kampuni inayoeleza kazi atakayofanya na muda wake.
sw.note: Visa hii haiongezwi wala haibadilishwi bila kibali maalum cha Kamishna Jenerali wa Uhamiaji.

en.text: Issued once to a foreigner coming for specific short assignments (up to 90 days) — e.g. installing or repairing machines, short training, auditing or lawful business.
list: Passport valid for at least 6 months.
Visa fee (USD 250).
1 photo and return ticket.
Registration documents of the inviting company (business licence or Certificate of Incorporation).
Contract or company letter describing the assignment and its duration.
en.note: Not renewable or extendable without special permission of the Commissioner General.

q.sw: Multiple Entry Visa ni nini?
q.en: What is a Multiple Entry Visa?

sw.text: Ni visa ya kuingia mara nyingi kwa wanaohitaji kutembelea Tanzania mara kwa mara — mf. wakurugenzi wa kampuni wasioishi nchini, wanafamilia (family re-union), washauri na wawakilishi wa mikataba. Inadumu hadi miezi 12, lakini mwenye visa hii lazima atoke nchini angalau kila baada ya miezi 3.
list: Pasipoti yenye muda usiopungua miezi 6, picha 1 na tiketi ya kurudi.
Ada ya visa (USD 100).
Fomu ya Security Bond iliyojazwa.
Usajili wa kampuni mwenyeji (kwa safari rasmi).
Barua ya mwenyeji au ushahidi unaoonyesha haja ya kuja mara kwa mara.
sw.note: Raia wa Marekani (USA) wanaokuja kwa utalii wanatakiwa kuomba Multiple Entry Visa. Visa hii si kwa ajili ya kazi za kibiashara zilizo chini ya Business Visa.

en.text: A visa for frequent visitors — e.g. non-resident company directors, family members (family re-union), consultants and bilateral representatives. Valid up to 12 months, but the holder must leave the country at least every 3 months.
list: Passport valid 6+ months, 1 photo and return ticket.
Visa fee (USD 100).
Completed Security Bond form.
Host company registration (for official visits).
Host letter or evidence of the need for frequent travel.
en.note: US citizens visiting for tourism must apply for a Multiple Entry Visa. It is not meant for business assignments covered by the Business Visa.

q.sw: Student Visa inapatikanaje?
q.en: How do I get a Student Visa?

sw.text: Hutolewa kwa mgeni anayekuja kusoma. Huombwa mtandaoni mwanafunzi akiwa bado nje ya Tanzania, akiwa amepata udahili kwenye chuo au taasisi inayotambulika.
list: Barua ya udahili na hati ya usajili wa taasisi viunganishwe kwenye PDF moja na kupakiwa.
Ada: USD 50 (miezi 3), USD 250 (hadi miaka 2), USD 300 (watafiti), USD 550 (PhD).
Vyuo vya kufundisha lugha haviruhusiwi kutoa visa ya miaka 2 — wanaojifunza lugha huomba visa ya miezi 3 tu.
sw.note: Aliyeshaingia nchini anaomba Student Pass, si Student Visa.

en.text: For foreigners coming to study. Apply online while still outside Tanzania, with admission to a recognised institution.
list: Admission letter and the institution's registration must be combined into one PDF and uploaded.
Fees: USD 50 (3 months), USD 250 (up to 2 years), USD 300 (researchers), USD 550 (PhD).
Language schools cannot offer 2-year validity — language students apply for a 3-month visa only.
en.note: Anyone already in the country applies for a Student Pass, not a Student Visa.

q.sw: Transit Visa ni nini?
q.en: What is a Transit Visa?

sw.text: Hutolewa kwa mgeni anayepita Tanzania kwenda nchi nyingine, kwa muda usiozidi siku 7. Haitumiki kwa utalii.
list: Nakala ya pasipoti halali.
Visa ya nchi unayokwenda au tiketi ya kuendelea na safari.
Ada ya visa (USD 30).

en.text: Issued to a foreigner passing through Tanzania to another country, for up to 7 days. It cannot be used for tourism.
list: Copy of a valid passport.
Visa of the destination country or onward ticket.
Visa fee (USD 30).

q.sw: Raia wa Marekani (USA) anaomba visa gani?
q.en: Which visa do US citizens apply for?

sw.text: Kutokana na makubaliano kati ya Tanzania na Marekani, raia wa Marekani wanaokuja kwa utalii, mapumziko au madhumuni mengine wanaomba Multiple Entry Visa (USD 100), yenye muda wa hadi miezi 12.

en.text: Under the bilateral arrangement, US citizens coming for tourism, holidays or other purposes apply for a Multiple Entry Visa (USD 100), valid up to 12 months.

q.sw: Gratis (Diplomatic) Visa ni nini?
q.en: What is a Gratis (Diplomatic) Visa?

sw.text: Ni visa isiyolipiwa ada, ya kuingia mara moja au mara nyingi, kwa wenye pasipoti za kidiplomasia, kiutumishi au rasmi, au hati za kusafiria za mashirika ya kimataifa yanayotambulika, walio kwenye kazi rasmi pamoja na wategemezi wao. Inaweza pia kutolewa kwa wenye pasipoti za kawaida kwa maelekezo ya Kamishna Jenerali au Kamishna wa Uhamiaji Zanzibar.

en.text: A free single- or multiple-entry visa for holders of diplomatic, service or official passports, or travel documents of recognised international organisations, on official duty, and their dependants. It may also be issued to ordinary passport holders on the direction of the Commissioner General or the Commissioner of Immigration Zanzibar.

q.sw: Ada za visa ni kiasi gani?
q.en: How much are visa fees?

list: Ordinary Visa: USD 50
Business Visa: USD 250
Multiple Entry Visa: USD 100
Transit Visa: USD 30
Student Visa: USD 50 (miezi 3), USD 250 (hadi miaka 2), USD 300 (watafiti), USD 550 (PhD)
Gratis/Diplomatic Visa: bila malipo
sw.note: Ada hulipwa mtandaoni kwa kadi ya Visa au MasterCard. Ada ya visa iliyokataliwa hairudishwi.

list: Ordinary Visa: USD 50
Business Visa: USD 250
Multiple Entry Visa: USD 100
Transit Visa: USD 30
Student Visa: USD 50 (3 months), USD 250 (up to 2 years), USD 300 (research), USD 550 (PhD)
Gratis/Diplomatic Visa: free
en.note: Fees are paid online by Visa or MasterCard. Fees for rejected applications are not refunded.

q.sw: Ni nchi gani raia wake hawahitaji visa?
q.en: Which nationals do not need a visa?

aliases: countries that do not require visa

sw.text: Raia wa nchi hizi hawahitaji kuomba visa kuingia Tanzania (hupewa Visitor's Pass wakifika):
list: Afrika Mashariki na jirani: Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Sudan Kusini, DRC, Zambia, Malawi, Msumbiji, Zimbabwe, Angola.
SADC na Afrika nyingine: Afrika Kusini, Botswana, Namibia, Lesotho, Eswatini (Swaziland), Madagascar, Mauritius, Seychelles, Ghana, Gambia.
Asia: Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei, Hong Kong, Macao.
Ulaya: Cyprus, Malta, Romania.

Karibiani na Pasifiki: Jamaica, Trinidad & Tobago, Barbados, Bahamas, Grenada, St. Lucia, St. Kitts, Dominica, Belize, Guyana, Papua New Guinea, Samoa, Tonga, Vanuatu, Solomon, Kiribati, Tuvalu, Nauru na visiwa vingine vidogo.
sw.note: Orodha inaweza kubadilika — hakiki kwenye immigration.go.tz kabla ya kusafiri.

en.text: Nationals of these countries do not need to apply for a visa (they receive a Visitor's Pass on arrival):
list: East Africa and neighbours: Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, DRC, Zambia, Malawi, Mozambique, Zimbabwe, Angola.
SADC and other Africa: South Africa, Botswana, Namibia, Lesotho, Eswatini, Madagascar, Mauritius, Seychelles, Ghana, Gambia.
Asia: Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei, Hong Kong, Macao.
Europe: Cyprus, Malta, Romania.

Caribbean and Pacific: Jamaica, Trinidad & Tobago, Barbados, Bahamas, Grenada, St. Lucia, St. Kitts, Dominica, Belize, Guyana, Papua New Guinea, Samoa, Tonga, Vanuatu, Solomon Islands, Kiribati, Tuvalu, Nauru and other small territories.
en.note: The list may change — check immigration.go.tz before travelling.

q.sw: Referral Visa ni nini na inahusu nchi gani?
q.en: What is a Referral Visa and which countries?

sw.text: Raia wa nchi fulani hawapewi visa wakifika mpakani — lazima waombe mtandaoni na kusubiri idhini kabla ya kusafiri. Nchi hizo ni:
list: Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Burkina Faso, Chad, Eritrea, Guinea Bissau, Guinea Conakry, Iran, Iraq, Kyrgyzstan, Lebanon, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Pakistan, Palestina, Somalia, Sierra Leone, Syria, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Yemen.
Pia watu wasio na uraia (stateless) na wakimbizi wenye hati za Vienna Convention.
sw.note: Omba angalau miezi 2 kabla ya safari. Usikate tiketi wala kulipia malazi kabla ya idhini. Ambatisha barua ya mwenyeji (taasisi au mtu) inayoeleza madhumuni na muda wa ziara, nyaraka za usajili wa taasisi mwenyeji, na nakala ya pasipoti/kibali au NIDA ya mwenyeji.

en.text: Nationals of certain countries cannot get a visa on arrival — they must apply online and wait for approval before travelling. They are:
list: Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Burkina Faso, Chad, Eritrea, Guinea Bissau, Guinea Conakry, Iran, Iraq, Kyrgyzstan, Lebanon, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Pakistan, Palestine, Somalia, Sierra Leone, Syria, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Yemen.
Also stateless persons and refugees holding Vienna Convention documents.
en.note: Apply at least 2 months before travel. Do not buy tickets or pay for bookings before approval. Attach a host letter stating purpose and duration, the host institution's registration, and the host's passport/permit or NIDA copy.

q.sw: Naweza kupata visa nikifika uwanjani au mpakani?
q.en: Can I get a visa on arrival?

sw.text: Raia wa nchi nyingi wanaweza kuomba visa mtandaoni au wakifika kwenye kituo cha kuingilia. Hata hivyo, inashauriwa kuomba mtandaoni mapema. Raia wa nchi zilizo kwenye kundi la Referral Visa hawawezi kupata visa wakifika — lazima waombe na kupata idhini kabla ya safari.

en.text: Nationals of many countries may apply online or on arrival at an entry point, though applying online in advance is recommended. Referral Visa nationals cannot get a visa on arrival — they must apply and be approved before travelling.

q.sw: Kibali cha Ukaazi (Residence Permit) ni nini na nani anakihitaji?
q.en: What is a Residence Permit and who needs one?

sw.text: Ni kibali kinachomruhusu mgeni kuishi Tanzania kwa ajili ya uwekezaji, biashara, ajira au shughuli nyingine halali. Mambo muhimu:
list: Waombaji ni kampuni/taasisi zilizosajiliwa Tanzania, au watu binafsi (wastaafu, wanaotibiwa, watafiti, wenye kesi mahakamani, wanunuzi wa nyumba n.k.).
Maombi yawasilishwe na kuidhinishwa mgeni akiwa bado nje ya Tanzania.
Wengi wanatakiwa kwanza kupata Kibali cha Kazi (Work Permit) kutoka kwa Kamishna wa Kazi — isipokuwa watafiti, wastaafu na wanaohudhuria kesi.
Mamlaka ya kutoa kibali ni ya Kamishna Jenerali wa Uhamiaji; asiyeridhika na uamuzi anaweza kukata rufaa kwa Waziri wa Mambo ya Ndani akiwa nje ya nchi.

en.text: A permit allowing a foreigner to live in Tanzania for investment, business, employment or other lawful activity. Key points:
list: Applicants are companies/institutions registered in Tanzania, or individuals (retirees, patients, researchers, court parties, real-estate buyers, etc.).
Applications must be lodged and approved while the foreigner is still outside Tanzania.
Most need a Work Permit from the Labour Commissioner first — except researchers, retirees and court attendees.
The Commissioner General of Immigration issues permits; appeals go to the Minister for Home Affairs while outside the country.

q.sw: Kuna madaraja gani ya vibali vya ukaazi?
q.en: What classes of residence permits are there?

sw.text: Kuna madaraja matatu:
list: Class A — wawekezaji waliojiajiri (mf. wawekezaji wa kawaida, Diaspora, wasanii wawekezaji, wakimbizi wawekezaji).
Class B — wageni walioajiriwa na kampuni au taasisi, wenye ujuzi adimu usiopatikana kwa urahisi nchini.

Class C — makundi mengine: watafiti, wastaafu (miaka 55+), wamisionari, wanaojitolea, wanafunzi wa mafunzo kwa vitendo (intern), wanaotibiwa, waajiriwa wa NGO, wenye kesi mahakamani, wanunuzi wa nyumba, wanaohitimisha shughuli (winding up) n.k.

en.text: There are three classes:
list: Class A — self-employed investors (general, Diaspora, artist and refugee investors).
Class B — employees of companies/institutions with skills not readily available locally.
Class C — others: researchers, retirees (55+), missionaries, volunteers, interns, patients, NGO employees, court parties, real-estate buyers, winding-up of affairs, etc.

q.sw: Kibali cha ukaazi kinadumu muda gani?
q.en: How long is a residence permit valid?

sw.text: Kibali cha daraja lolote hakizidi miaka 2 na kinaweza kuhuishwa. Muda halisi hutegemea mkataba wa ajira, muda wa leseni ya bodi ya taaluma husika, na muda wa Kibali cha Kazi.

en.text: Any class is valid for a maximum of 2 years and may be renewed. The actual period depends on the employment contract, the professional board licence and the Work Permit.

q.sw: Hali za utoaji (FG, RT, SG, RPL, RG1, RG2) zina maana gani?
q.en: What do issuance statuses (FG, RT, SG, RPL, RG1, RG2) mean?

list: FG (First Grant) — ombi la kwanza.
RT (Returnee) — anarejea kwenye taasisi yake ya awali baada ya kutokuwepo zaidi ya miaka 3.
SG (Second Grant) — anabadilisha daraja ndani ya taasisi ileile (mf. B kwenda A).
RPL (Replacement) — kuhuisha kibali kilichoisha muda.
RG1 (Re-Grant 1) — kuhamia taasisi nyingine kwa daraja lilelile.
RG2 (Re-Grant 2) — kuhamia taasisi nyingine kwa daraja tofauti.
FG (First Grant) — first application.
RT (Returnee) — rejoining the previous institution after more than 3 years away.
SG (Second Grant) — changing class in the same institution (e.g. B to A).
RPL (Replacement) — renewal after expiry.
RG1 — moving to another institution in the same class.
RG2 — moving to another institution in a different class.

q.sw: Nani anaomba kibali cha ukaazi — mimi au mwajiri?
q.en: Who applies for the permit — me or my employer?

list: Kwa ajira na uwekezaji: kampuni, taasisi au mwajiri aliyesajiliwa Tanzania ndiye huomba kwa niaba ya mgeni.
Kwa makundi binafsi (mstaafu, anayetibiwa, mtafiti, mwenye kesi mahakamani, mnunuzi wa nyumba, intern): mhusika au taasisi mwenyeji huomba.
Maombi hufanywa mtandaoni kupitia akaunti ya mfumo wa vibali.
For employment and investment: the company, institution or employer registered in Tanzania applies on the foreigner's behalf.
For individual categories (retirees, patients, researchers, court parties, real-estate buyers, interns): the person or host institution applies.
Applications are made online through a permit system account.

q.sw: Niko tayari Tanzania — naweza kuomba kibali cha ukaazi?
q.en: I am already in Tanzania — can I apply for a permit?

sw.text: Kwa kawaida hapana: maombi yanapaswa kuwasilishwa na kuidhinishwa ukiwa bado nje ya nchi. Isipokuwa:
list: Kuhuisha kibali (renewal) ukiwa tayari mkaazi.
Wastaafu na wanaohitimisha shughuli (winding up) wa Class C.
Mwajiri anayeomba kibali cha kwanza mgeni akiwa tayari nchini anaweza kutozwa ada ya Special Pass juu ya ada ya kibali.
sw.note: Kwa hali nyingine maalum, wasiliana na Idara kupitia info@immigration.go.tz.

en.text: Normally no: applications must be lodged and approved while you are still abroad. Exceptions:
list: Renewals while already resident.
Class C retirees and winding-up cases.
An employer applying for a first grant while the foreigner is already in the country may pay a Special Pass fee on top.
en.note: For other special cases, contact info@immigration.go.tz.

q.sw: Ombi la kibali likikataliwa, nifanye nini?
q.en: What if my permit application is refused?

sw.text: Mamlaka ya kutoa kibali ni ya Kamishna Jenerali wa Uhamiaji. Mwombaji asiyeridhika na uamuzi anaweza kukata rufaa kwa Waziri wa Mambo ya Ndani ya Nchi akiwa nje ya nchi.

en.text: The Commissioner General of Immigration issues permits. An applicant dissatisfied with the decision may appeal to the Minister for Home Affairs while outside the country.

q.sw: Masharti ya Kibali cha Ukaazi Class A (mwekezaji)?
q.en: Class A (investor) permit requirements?

sw.text: Class A hutolewa kwa mgeni anayewekeza na kujiajiri. Mtaji wa kampuni usipungue kiwango kilichowekwa na Sheria ya Uwekezaji. Viambatisho vikuu:
list: Ombi la mtandaoni, barua ya maombi na Kibali cha Kazi kutoka kwa Kamishna wa Kazi.
Nakala ya pasipoti (muda usiopungua miezi 6), pasipoti za wategemezi (kama wapo) na picha.
Cheti cha usajili wa kampuni, MEMARTS/orodha ya wanahisa na wakurugenzi kutoka BRELA/ZBPRA.
Leseni ya biashara, TIN na Tax Clearance halali.
Mkataba wa pango au hati ya umiliki wa eneo, ushahidi wa mtaji na taarifa za fedha.
Cheti cha vivutio (TIC/ZIPA/EPZA) na leseni ya mamlaka ya sekta husika pale inapohitajika.
Mikataba ya wafanyakazi wazawa na hali ya ukaazi ya wanahisa wengine.
sw.note: Wakimbizi wawekezaji huongeza kibali kutoka Idara ya Huduma kwa Wakimbizi na kitambulisho cha ukimbizi.

en.text: Class A is for foreigners who invest and are self-employed. Company capital must not be below the minimum set by the Investment Act. Key documents:
list: Online application, application letter and a Work Permit from the Labour Commissioner.
Passport copy (6+ months validity), dependants' passports and photo.
Company registration, MEMARTS/shareholders and directors from BRELA/ZBPRA.
Business licence, TIN and valid Tax Clearance.
Lease or title deed, evidence of capital and financial statements.
Incentive certificate (TIC/ZIPA/EPZA) and sector regulator licence where required.
Local employees' contracts and other shareholders' immigration status.
en.note: Refugee investors also need clearance from the Refugee Services Department and refugee ID.

q.sw: Masharti ya Kibali cha Ukaazi Class B (mwajiriwa)?
q.en: Class B (employee) permit requirements?

sw.text: Class B hutolewa kwa mgeni mwenye ujuzi adimu (hasa wa kitaalamu) asiopatikana kwa urahisi nchini, aliyepata ajira maalum kwa mwajiri maalum. Ombi lifanywe kabla mwajiriwa hajaingia nchini. Viambatisho vikuu:
list: Ombi la mtandaoni, barua ya maombi na Kibali cha Kazi kutoka kwa Kamishna wa Kazi.
Nakala ya pasipoti (miezi 6+), pasipoti za wategemezi na picha.
CV, vyeti vya taaluma vilivyothibitishwa (na tafsiri rasmi kama si Kiingereza/Kiswahili).
Maelezo ya kazi (job description), mkataba wa ajira na muundo wa taasisi.
Usajili wa bodi ya taaluma pale inapohitajika (mf. ERB kwa wahandisi, Medical Council kwa madaktari, NBAA kwa wahasibu).
Leseni ya biashara, cheti cha usajili wa kampuni, TIN, Tax Clearance na orodha ya wakurugenzi kutoka BRELA/ZBPRA.
Barua ya kutokuwa na pingamizi (kama anatoka kampuni nyingine).

en.text: Class B is for foreigners with rare (mostly technical) skills not readily available locally, with specific employment by a specific employer. Apply before the employee enters Tanzania. Key documents:
list: Online application, application letter and Work Permit from the Labour Commissioner.
Passport copy (6+ months), dependants' passports and photo.
CV and certified academic certificates (with official translation if not English/Kiswahili).
Job description, employment contract and organisation structure.
Professional board registration where required (e.g. ERB, Medical Council, NBAA).
Business licence, company registration, TIN, Tax Clearance and directors from BRELA/ZBPRA.
Letter of no objection (if moving from another company).

q.sw: Masharti ya Kibali cha Ukaazi Class C?
q.en: Class C permit requirements?

sw.text: Class C ni kwa wageni wasiostahili Class A au B. Viambatisho vya jumla: ombi la mtandaoni, barua ya taasisi, Kibali cha Kazi au barua ya msamaha (wamisionari, wanaojitolea, NGO), nakala ya pasipoti (miezi 6+) na picha. Kisha kulingana na kundi:
list: Watafiti: kibali cha utafiti cha COSTECH, CV, vyeti na barua ya chuo.
Wastaafu (miaka 55+): ushahidi wa mafao/kipato, barua ya kustaafu na ushahidi wa makazi.
Wamisionari: cheti cha upadri/uchungaji, mkataba na maelezo ya kazi.
Wanaojitolea: mkataba wa kujitolea na maelezo ya kazi.
Matibabu: ushahidi wa ugonjwa kutoka hospitali ya Serikali/rufaa.
Waajiriwa wa NGO: mkataba, maelezo ya kazi na ushahidi wa shughuli za NGO.
Wenye kesi mahakamani: ushahidi wa kesi.
Intern: barua ya taasisi mwenyeji, ushahidi wa ufadhili na idhini ya Wizara ya Elimu.
Wanunuzi wa nyumba: thamani ya mali isiyopungua USD 100,000, hati ya umiliki, Police Clearance na barua ya TIC/ZIPA.
sw.note: Ombi lifanywe kabla ya kuingia nchini, isipokuwa wastaafu na wanaohitimisha shughuli (winding up).

en.text: Class C is for foreigners not eligible for A or B. General documents: online application, institution letter, Work Permit or exemption letter (missionaries, volunteers, NGOs), passport copy (6+ months) and photo. Then by category:
list: Researchers: COSTECH research permit, CV, certificates and university letter.
Retirees (55+): evidence of retirement income, retirement letter and proof of residence.
Missionaries: ordination certificate, contract and job description.
Volunteers: volunteer contract and job description.
Medical treatment: evidence of illness from a government/referral hospital.
NGO employees: contract, job description and evidence of NGO activities.
Court parties/witnesses: evidence of the case.
Interns: host letter, sponsorship evidence and Ministry of Education approval.
Real-estate buyers: property worth at least USD 100,000, title deed, Police Clearance and TIC/ZIPA letter.
en.note: Apply before entering Tanzania, except retirees and winding-up cases.

q.sw: Mstaafu wa kigeni anawezaje kuishi Tanzania?
q.en: How can a foreign retiree live in Tanzania?

sw.text: Kupitia Kibali cha Ukaazi Class C (C-2: Retired persons) kwa watu wenye umri wa miaka 55 au zaidi wenye kipato cha uhakika cha kujikimu wao na wategemezi wao.
list: Ushahidi wa mafao au kipato cha kustaafu.
Barua ya kustaafu na ushahidi wa makazi.
Waliostaafu wakiwa Tanzania warudishe kibali chao cha awali.
Ada: USD 500 (EAC na Diaspora USD 250) + Re-entry Pass USD 50.
sw.note: Wastaafu wanaweza kuomba wakiwa tayari nchini.

en.text: Through a Class C permit (C-2: Retired persons) for people aged 55+ with an assured income for themselves and their dependants.
list: Evidence of retirement benefits or income.
Retirement letter and proof of residence.
Those who retired in Tanzania surrender their previous permit.
Fee: USD 500 (EAC and Diaspora USD 250) + Re-entry Pass USD 50.
en.note: Retirees may apply while already in the country.

q.sw: Mgeni aliyenunua nyumba Tanzania anapataje kibali?
q.en: Can a foreigner who buys a house get a permit?

sw.text: Ndiyo, kupitia Class C (C-11: Buyer of real estate) kwa wanunuzi wa nyumba katika biashara ya nyumba wasiostahili makundi mengine. Masharti:
list: Thamani ya mali isiyopungua USD 100,000.
Hati ya umiliki (Certificate of Occupancy/Title deed).
Police Clearance kutoka nchi anakotoka au anakoishi.
Barua ya mapendekezo kutoka TIC (Bara) au ZIPA (Zanzibar) na Tax Clearance.
Ada: USD 500 (EAC na Diaspora USD 250).

en.text: Yes, through Class C (C-11: Buyer of real estate) for home buyers not eligible for other categories. Requirements:
list: Property value of at least USD 100,000.
Title deed/Certificate of Occupancy.
Police Clearance from the country of origin or residence.
Recommendation letter from TIC (Mainland) or ZIPA (Zanzibar) and Tax Clearance.
Fee: USD 500 (EAC and Diaspora USD 250).

q.sw: Wataalamu wa kigeni wanahitaji usajili gani wa bodi?
q.en: Which professional registrations do foreign experts need?

list: Wahandisi: ERB.
Madaktari: Medical Council of Tanganyika.
Wauguzi: Nurses and Midwifery Council.
Wahasibu: NBAA.
Wanasheria: kibali cha Mahakama Kuu na TLS.
Wakadiriaji majenzi/wasanifu: AQRB.
Wahadhiri (Dr/Prof): TCU.
Walimu: leseni ya kufundisha.
Marubani: leseni ya TCAA.
Benki: kibali cha BOT; Bima: TIRA.
Intern: barua ya Wizara ya Elimu.
Engineers: ERB.
Doctors: Medical Council of Tanganyika.
Nurses: Nurses and Midwifery Council.
Accountants: NBAA.
Lawyers: High Court clearance and TLS.
Quantity surveyors/architects: AQRB.
Lecturers (Dr/Prof): TCU.
Teachers: teaching licence.
Pilots: TCAA licence.
Banks: BOT clearance; insurers: TIRA.
Interns: Ministry of Education letter.

q.sw: Ninaombaje kibali cha ukaazi mtandaoni?
q.en: How do I apply for a residence permit online?

aliases: jinsi ya kuomba kibali cha kuishi
how to apply for a residence permit

sw.text: Kwa kawaida kibali huombwa na kampuni au mwajiri mgeni akiwa bado nje ya nchi.
steps: Pata kwanza Kibali cha Kazi kutoka kwa Kamishna wa Kazi (kazi.go.tz), pale kinapohitajika.
Fungua immigration.go.tz → e-Services → Residence Permit, na soma mwongozo wa vibali.
Fungua akaunti (barua pepe, simu, anwani na nenosiri).
Jaza fomu, ambatisha nyaraka zote na wasilisha.
Ombi likiidhinishwa kwa malipo, lipa ndani ya siku 60 — vinginevyo ombi hufutwa lenyewe.
Baada ya malipo utapokea Enrolment Notification: fika ofisi ya Uhamiaji kwa alama za vidole na picha.
Kibali hutolewa ndani ya wiki moja; hukichukua Ofisi ya Uhamiaji ya Mkoa, Makao Makuu, Afisi Kuu Zanzibar, TIC, EPZA au ZIPA.
sw.note: Mwajiri anayeomba kibali cha kwanza mgeni akiwa tayari nchini anaweza kutozwa ada ya Special Pass juu ya ada ya kibali. Waliosajiliwa TIC, EPZA au ZIPA wanaweza kuwasilisha kupitia madirisha yao.

en.text: Normally the company/employer applies while the foreigner is still abroad.
steps: First obtain a Work Permit from the Labour Commissioner (kazi.go.tz) where required.
Open immigration.go.tz → e-Services → Residence Permit and read the guidelines.
Create an account (email, phone, address and password).
Fill the form, attach all documents and submit.
When approved for payment, pay within 60 days — otherwise the application is deleted automatically.
After payment you receive an Enrolment Notification: visit an immigration office for fingerprints and photo.
The permit is issued within a week and collected at the Regional office, Headquarters, Zanzibar Head Office, TIC, EPZA or ZIPA.
en.note: An employer applying for a first grant while the foreigner is already in the country may pay a Special Pass fee on top. TIC, EPZA and ZIPA registrants may submit through their windows.

q.sw: Ada za vibali vya ukaazi ni kiasi gani?
q.en: How much are residence permit fees?

sw.text: Ada (kwa USD) hutegemea daraja na kundi; raia wa Afrika Mashariki (EAC) na Diaspora hupata punguzo:
list: Class A: Mwekezaji wa kawaida 3,000 (EAC 1,500); Msanii mwekezaji 1,000 (EAC 500); Diaspora 1,000; Mkimbizi mwekezaji 1,500.
Class B: Ajira ya kawaida 2,000 (EAC 500); Diaspora 500; Kibali cha muda mfupi (hadi miezi 6) 500; Wakimbizi 500.

Class C: Watafiti, wastaafu, NGO, wenye kesi, wasanii, wanunuzi wa nyumba na wengineo 500 (EAC 250); Wamisionari, wanaojitolea, wanaotibiwa, intern na wanaohitimisha shughuli 200 (EAC 100); Wakimbizi — bila malipo.
sw.note: Kila mwombaji na mtegemezi hulipia pia Re-entry Pass ya USD 50 (USD 250 kwa kibali cha muda mfupi Class B).

en.text: Fees (USD) depend on class and category; EAC citizens and Diaspora get reductions:
list: Class A: general investor 3,000 (EAC 1,500); artist investor 1,000 (EAC 500); Diaspora 1,000; refugee investor 1,500.
Class B: standard employment 2,000 (EAC 500); Diaspora 500; short-term (up to 6 months) 500; refugees 500.
Class C: researchers, retirees, NGO, court parties, artists, real-estate buyers and others 500 (EAC 250); missionaries, volunteers, patients, interns and winding-up 200 (EAC 100); refugees — free.
en.note: Each applicant and dependant also pays a Re-entry Pass of USD 50 (USD 250 for short-term Class B).

q.sw: Ninafuatiliaje ombi la kibali cha ukaazi?
q.en: How do I track my residence permit application?

sw.text: Ingia kwenye akaunti yako ya maombi. Utaona:
list: Submitted Application Status — hali ya ombi.
Pending Application — hoja au nyaraka zinazokosekana (utaarifiwa pia kwa barua pepe). Jibu hoja au ambatisha nyaraka ili ombi liendelee.
Pending Payment — maelekezo ya malipo (lipa ndani ya siku 60).

en.text: Sign in to your application account. You will see:
list: Submitted Application Status — progress.
Pending Application — queries or missing documents (also notified by email). Respond so processing continues.
Pending Payment — payment instructions (pay within 60 days).

q.sw: Exemption Certificate ni nini?
q.en: What is an Exemption Certificate?

sw.text: Ni hati ya ukaazi isiyolipiwa ada, inayotolewa kwa:
list: Wanadiplomasia pamoja na wake/waume na watoto wao wategemezi.
Wataalamu wa kigeni walio kwenye miradi ya Serikali.
Wanafunzi kutoka nchi za Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki (EAC).
sw.note: Viambatisho: barua ya taasisi, fomu iliyojazwa, barua ya Utumishi (si kwa wanafunzi wa EAC), msamaha wa Kibali cha Kazi, nakala ya pasipoti, picha, CV na vyeti. Wanafunzi wa EAC huongeza barua ya udahili ya chuo.

en.text: A fee-free residence document issued to:
list: Diplomats and their spouses and dependent children.
Foreign experts on Government projects.
Students from East African Community (EAC) states.
en.note: Documents: institution letter, completed form, Public Service letter (not for EAC students), Work Permit exemption, passport copy, photos, CV and certificates. EAC students add the admission letter.

q.sw: Kibali cha ukaazi kinachukuliwa wapi na baada ya muda gani?
q.en: Where and when do I collect my permit?

sw.text: Baada ya malipo na kuchukuliwa alama za vidole na picha, kibali hushughulikiwa na kutolewa ndani ya wiki moja. Hukichukua Ofisi ya Uhamiaji ya Mkoa ambapo kampuni ipo, Uhamiaji Makao Makuu, Afisi Kuu Zanzibar, au kupitia TIC, EPZA au ZIPA kulingana na ulikowasilisha.

en.text: After payment and fingerprint/photo enrolment, the permit is processed and issued within a week. Collect it at the Regional Immigration Office where the company is located, Immigration Headquarters, the Zanzibar Head Office, or through TIC, EPZA or ZIPA as applicable.

q.sw: Pasi (Pass) ni nini na zipo za aina gani?
q.en: What is a Pass and what types exist?

sw.text: Pasi ni hadhi ya kiuhamiaji inayompa mgeni ruhusa ya kuingia na kukaa nchini kwa madhumuni maalum, tofauti na kibali cha ukaazi. Muda wake hauzidi miaka 2. Aina kuu:
list: Dependant Pass — wategemezi wa raia au mkaazi.
Student Pass — wanafunzi walio nchini.
Business Pass — kazi za muda mfupi kwa raia wa nchi zisizohitaji visa.
Visitor's Pass — wageni kutoka nchi zisizohitaji visa.
Re-entry Pass — wakaazi wanaosafiri na kurudi.
In-Transit Pass — kupita nchini hadi siku 7.
Landing Pass — wafanyakazi wa meli.
Interim Pass — kusubiri uamuzi au kupata kibali.
Special Pass (EAC) — raia wa EAC hadi siku 90.
Migrant Pass na Seasonal Migrant Pass — wahamiaji wa muda mrefu na wa msimu.
sw.note: Viambatisho vya jumla: nakala ya pasipoti halali, barua ya taasisi, pasi ya awali (ukihuisha) na ada husika. Huombwa mtandaoni kupitia e-Pass.

en.text: A Pass is an immigration status allowing a foreigner to enter and stay for a specific purpose, distinct from a residence permit. Maximum validity is 2 years. Main types:
list: Dependant Pass — dependants of citizens or residents.
Student Pass — students already in the country.
Business Pass — short assignments for visa-exempt nationals.
Visitor's Pass — visitors from visa-exempt countries.
Re-entry Pass — residents travelling and returning.
In-Transit Pass — passing through up to 7 days.
Landing Pass — ship crew.
Interim Pass — awaiting a decision or permit.
Special Pass (EAC) — EAC nationals up to 90 days.
Migrant Pass and Seasonal Migrant Pass — long-term and seasonal migrants.
en.note: General documents: valid passport copy, institution letter, previous pass (renewal) and the fee. Apply online via e-Pass.

q.sw: Ninaombaje pasi, na inadumu muda gani?
q.en: How do I apply for a pass, and how long is it valid?

steps: Omba mtandaoni kupitia e-Pass (immigration.go.tz → e-Services → Pass).
Ambatisha nakala ya pasipoti halali, barua ya taasisi husika na viambatisho maalum vya aina ya pasi.
Kwa kuhuisha, ambatisha pasi ya awali.
Lipa ada husika ya aina ya pasi.
sw.note: Muda wa pasi yoyote hauzidi miaka 2. Re-entry Pass hudumu kwa muda wa kibali au pasi uliyonayo.

steps: Apply online via e-Pass (immigration.go.tz → e-Services → Pass).
Attach a valid passport copy, the institution's letter and the pass-specific documents.
For renewal, attach the previous pass.
Pay the relevant fee.
en.note: No pass is valid for more than 2 years. A Re-entry Pass lasts as long as your current permit or pass.

q.sw: Dependant Pass inapatikanaje?
q.en: How do I get a Dependant Pass?

sw.text: Hutolewa kwa mke, watoto au ndugu wa karibu wanaomtegemea raia au mkaazi halali. Viambatisho:
list: Fomu ya Security Bond yenye stempu ya ushuru ya Tsh 500 kutoka TRA.
Nakala ya pasipoti ya mwombaji na ya mtegemezi, na picha (soft copy).
Cheti cha ndoa (mke), cheti cha kuzaliwa (mtoto au mzazi).
Kama mwombaji si raia: kibali chake (Exemption, Class A, B au C).
Ukihuisha: Dependant Pass ya awali.
sw.note: Ada ni USD 550 (EAC USD 300). Kwa mke wa kigeni aliyeolewa na Mtanzania ada ni Tsh 200,000. Mtoto wa kiume aliyezidi miaka 18 hastahili kuwa mtegemezi.

en.text: Issued to a wife, children or close relatives dependent on a citizen or legal resident. Documents:
list: Security Bond form with a Tsh 500 TRA stamp duty.
Passport copies of applicant and dependant, and a photo (soft copy).
Marriage certificate (wife), birth certificate (child or parent).
If the applicant is not a citizen: their permit (Exemption, Class A, B or C).
For renewal: the previous Dependant Pass.
en.note: Fee USD 550 (EAC USD 300). For a foreign wife married to a Tanzanian the fee is Tsh 200,000. A son over 18 cannot be a dependant.

q.sw: Student Pass inapatikanaje?
q.en: How do I get a Student Pass?

sw.text: Kuna aina mbili:
list: Student Pass I — wanafunzi wa taasisi zinazotambulika, wakiwemo watoto wa wakaazi waliofikia umri wa utu uzima. Viambatisho: usajili wa taasisi, ushahidi wa ufadhili, ushahidi wa usajili (enrolment), barua ya udahili na joining instructions. Ada USD 200 (EAC bure).

Student Pass II — watoto wa wakaazi walio chini ya umri wa utu uzima wasioandikwa kwenye vibali vya wazazi (chekechea hadi elimu ya juu). Viambatisho: barua ya udahili, ufadhili, idhini ya mzazi/mlezi, kibali cha mzazi, vyeti vya kuzaliwa na pasipoti ya mzazi. Ada USD 100 (EAC bure).
sw.note: Nakala zote zithibitishwe. Vyuo vya lugha haviruhusiwi kutoa pasi ya miaka 2.

en.text: There are two types:
list: Student Pass I — students at approved institutions, including adult children of residents. Documents: institution registration, sponsorship, enrolment evidence, admission letter and joining instructions. Fee USD 200 (EAC free).

Student Pass II — minor children of residents not endorsed on their parents' permits (kindergarten to higher learning). Documents: admission letter, sponsorship, parent/guardian consent, parent's permit, birth certificates and parent's passport. Fee USD 100 (EAC free).
en.note: All copies must be certified. Language schools cannot offer 2-year validity.

q.sw: Business Pass ni nini?
q.en: What is a Business Pass?

sw.text: Hutolewa kwa raia wa nchi zisizohitaji visa kuingia Tanzania, kwa kazi maalum za muda mfupi — mf. ukaguzi wa hesabu, kutengeneza mitambo, upembuzi yakinifu, kuanzisha mawasiliano ya kibiashara au maandalizi ya uwekezaji. Ada ni USD 200 (EAC USD 100).

en.text: Issued to nationals of visa-exempt countries for short assignments — e.g. auditing, machine repair, feasibility studies, business contacts or investment start-up. Fee USD 200 (EAC USD 100).

q.sw: Visitor's Pass ni nini?
q.en: What is a Visitor's Pass?

sw.text: Hutolewa ukifika nchini kwa wageni kutoka nchi zisizohitaji visa, kwa ajili ya kutembelea ndugu/marafiki, mapumziko, kusafiri, mikutano, matibabu, kuhudhuria mahakama au sababu nyingine za msingi.
sw.note: Mwenye Visitor's Pass haruhusiwi kufanya ajira, biashara wala kazi ya kitaaluma.

en.text: Issued on arrival to visitors from visa-exempt countries for visiting friends/relatives, holidays, travel, meetings, treatment, appearing in court or other sufficient reasons.
en.note: A Visitor's Pass holder may not engage in employment, trade, business or professional activity.

q.sw: Re-entry Pass ni nini?
q.en: What is a Re-entry Pass?

sw.text: Humwezesha mgeni mkaazi wa Tanzania kusafiri nje na kurudi bila kupoteza hadhi yake ya ukaazi. Inadumu kwa muda wa kibali au pasi aliyonayo. Kwa wenye vibali vya ukaazi, ada yake ni USD 50 kwa kila mwombaji na mtegemezi.

en.text: Enables a foreign resident to travel abroad and return without losing residence status. Valid for the duration of the current permit or pass. For permit holders the fee is USD 50 per applicant and dependant.

q.sw: In-Transit Pass na Landing Pass ni nini?
q.en: What are the In-Transit and Landing Passes?

list: In-Transit Pass: kwa mgeni anayepita Tanzania kwenda nchi nyingine; haizidi siku 7.
Landing Pass: kwa mfanyakazi wa meli iliyowasili kwa bahari au ziwa katika safari isiyokatika, anayetaka kushuka nchi kavu kutembea au kwa sababu nyingine, kwa muda ambao meli iko bandarini.
In-Transit Pass: for a foreigner passing through Tanzania to another country; up to 7 days.
Landing Pass: for a crew member of a ship arriving by sea or lake on a continuous journey who wishes to go ashore while the ship is in port.

q.sw: Interim Pass na Special Pass ya EAC ni nini?
q.en: What are the Interim Pass and EAC Special Pass?

list: Interim Pass: humpa mgeni muda wa kufanyiwa uchunguzi ili kubaini kama anastahili kibali cha ukaazi, au kumpa nafasi ya kuomba na kupata kibali au pasi nyingine. Ada USD 600.
Special Pass (EAC): kwa raia wa nchi wanachama wa Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki waliopata ajira au wanaotaka kufanya biashara, taaluma au kazi ya muda kwa kipindi kisichozidi siku 90.
Interim Pass: gives a foreigner time for inquiry to determine eligibility for a residence permit, or a chance to apply for a permit or other pass. Fee USD 600.
Special Pass (EAC): for EAC nationals who secured employment or wish to do business, a profession or a temporary assignment for up to 90 days.

q.sw: Migrant Pass na Seasonal Migrant Pass ni nini?
q.en: What are the Migrant and Seasonal Migrant Passes?

list: Migrant Pass: kwa watu wenye asili ya Kiafrika kutoka nchi jirani walioingia Tanzania kabla ya 1972 na wanaendelea kuishi bila pasipoti au utambulisho wa nchi nyingine. Hutolewa kwa miaka 2. Viambatisho: barua za mapendekezo za VEO na WEO, barua ya Afisa Uhamiaji wa Mkoa, ushahidi wa kuwepo nchini tangu 1972 na vyeti vya kuzaliwa inapohitajika. Ada Tsh 10,000.

Seasonal Migrant Pass: kwa raia wa nchi jirani wanaokuja kufanya kazi za msimu (mf. kilimo, uvuvi). Mwajiri hujisajili, hujaza fomu mtandaoni kwa ajili ya kibarua wake kwa miezi 3 au 6, huichapisha na kuiwasilisha pamoja na vielelezo Ofisi ya Uhamiaji ya Mkoa.

Migrant Pass: for people of African descent from neighbouring countries who entered Tanzania before 1972 and still live here without another country's passport or ID. Issued for 2 years. Documents: VEO and WEO recommendation letters, Regional Immigration Officer letter, evidence of presence since 1972 and birth certificates where needed. Fee Tsh 10,000.

Seasonal Migrant Pass: for nationals of neighbouring countries doing seasonal work (e.g. farming, fishing). The employer registers, applies online for the worker for 3 or 6 months, prints and submits it with documents at the Regional Immigration Office.

q.sw: Nani anaweza kuwa mtegemezi (dependant)?
q.en: Who can be a dependant?

list: Mke (wife) wa raia au mkaazi halali.
Watoto.
Ndugu wa karibu, wakiwemo wazazi (baba/mama) wa mwombaji.
sw.note: Mtoto wa kiume aliyezidi miaka 18 hastahili kuwa mtegemezi — anaweza kuhitaji Student Pass au kibali chake mwenyewe.

list: The wife of a citizen or legal resident.
Children.
Near relatives, including the applicant's parents.
en.note: A son over 18 cannot be a dependant — he may need a Student Pass or his own permit.

q.sw: Tofauti ya Student Visa na Student Pass ni ipi?
q.en: Student Visa vs Student Pass — what's the difference?

aliases: tofauti ya visa na pasi ya mwanafunzi

list: Student Visa: huombwa mtandaoni mwanafunzi akiwa bado nje ya Tanzania, kabla ya kuja kusoma.
Student Pass: kwa mwanafunzi ambaye tayari yuko nchini (pamoja na watoto wa wakaazi wanaosoma hapa).
Student Visa: applied online while the student is still outside Tanzania, before coming to study.
Student Pass: for a student already in the country (including children of residents studying here).
